content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The traditional payment platforms impose steep fees, often reaching up to 10% per transaction, as seen with Gumroad. This can severely cut into your profits, especially when selling digital products like ebooks. In contrast, using NOWPayments allows you to accept Bitcoin with a mere 0.5% fee, preserving your margins. The infrastructure COREMERCH provides ensures that you remain unaffected by the restrictions these platforms impose. You own your entire stack, guaranteeing that you can operate without the threat of payment rejection or account freezes, which are common in these traditional systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your infrastructure, gather the essential components: a domain for your store, a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and a payment processor in NOWPayments. Additionally, set up a Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automated product delivery. Ensure you have your digital products ready, whether they are ebooks, templates, or other assets. By preparing these elements, you streamline the deployment process, enabling a smooth transition from concept to live sales.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept Bitcoin transactions. Then, integrate this with your chosen hosting solution. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to create a delivery mechanism for your digital products. This setup allows for automatic file delivery as soon as the payment is confirmed on-chain. With this pipeline, you ensure that every customer receives their product instantly after purchase, enhancing the user experience and increasing the likelihood of repeat sales.
NOWPayments retains more of your profits compared to traditional platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Direct traffic to your new store and monitor the performance. Start with a test transaction to ensure everything works flawlessly. After confirming that the payment processing and product delivery are functioning correctly, begin promoting your ebook sales. Use social media and other channels to drive awareness and traffic, ensuring that you capture initial sales while testing and optimizing your process.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your first transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Consider adding more products to your store and optimizing your sales funnel. Utilize the insights gained from initial sales data to refine your marketing strategies. Additionally, explore ways to enhance your infrastructure by integrating additional payment options or automating customer interactions. As you grow, the ability to adapt and scale your operations will be crucial in maximizing your profitability.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, leverage alternative payment processors like NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin. This approach eliminates traditional platform fees and gives you full control over your sales. By deploying a sovereign commerce stack, you can establish an independent online store that operates seamlessly within your chosen framework.
You control your sales without being dependent on third-party platforms.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Acquire a domain name for your store. Choose a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Create a NOWPayments account for Bitcoin transactions. Set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automated delivery. Prepare your digital products for sale. Test your payment and delivery pipeline with a trial transaction. Promote your newly established store to attract customers.
